import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Find the station with highest PM10 at 2025-10-05 14:00:00
query = """
SELECT station_id, pm10
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
ORDER BY pm10 DESC
LIMIT 1
"""
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("Station with highest PM10:")
print(df)

# Get station details
station_id = df['station_id'].values[0]
pm10_value = df['pm10'].values[0]
print(f"\nStation ID: {station_id}, PM10: {pm10_value}")

# Get station coordinates
query_station = """
SELECT id, name_en, coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = %d
""" % station_id
station_info = pd.read_sql(query_station, engine)
print(f"\nStation info: {station_info[['id', 'name_en']].to_string(index=False)}")

FROM air_quality_station

    query_traffic = """

    FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic
    WHERE road_segment_id IN (%s)
    AND datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
    """ % placeholders
    traffic_data = pd.read_sql(query_traffic, engine, params=road_ids)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get station coordinates for station 17 (Causeway Bay)
query_station = """
SELECT ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lng, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 17
"""
station_info = pd.read_sql(query_station, engine)
lng = station_info['lng'].values[0]
lat = station_info['lat'].values[0]
print(f"Station coordinates: lng={lng}, lat={lat}")

# Find road segments within 500m and get average speed directly
query_traffic = """
SELECT AVG(hrt.speed) as avg_speed
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE ST_DWithin(
    rs.geometry,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%s, %s), 4326)::geometry,
    500
)
AND hrt.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
""" % (lng, lat)

traffic_data = pd.read_sql(query_traffic, engine)
print(f"Average speed result:")
print(traffic_data)

if len(traffic_data) > 0:
    avg_speed = traffic_data['avg_speed'].values[0]
    avg_speed_near_pm10 = round(avg_speed, 1) if pd.notna(avg_speed) else None
    print(f"\nFinal answer - Average speed: {avg_speed_near_pm10}")
